rights_note: Original project artwork. No game-extracted assets, movie frames, actor likenesses or reference-game imagery included. Unofficial non-canonical fan project; franchise names remain in replaceable content.

assets.brief: Original human traveller in patched forest-green cloak, worn leather, broken sword and round shield. Isometric illustrated realism, transparent background. Idle, three walk poses, sword windup/contact/follow-through/recovery, guard, dodge, hit and death. Warm upper-left lighting. Not a famous character or actor.
assets.preparation: Inspected generated sheet, corrected layout, cropped and packed into equal transparent cells; WebP quality 90, alpha quality 100.

assets.brief: Same original traveller as reference. Row 1 only bow and quiver, idle/draw/release/recovery. Row 2 only two-handed iron axe, idle/raised anticipation/diagonal chop/low follow-through. Four evenly spaced columns, transparent gutters, consistent body size, three-quarter isometric view.
assets.preparation: Cropped into equal cells; poses selected by actual attack timing.

assets.brief: Original goblin, orc, siege troll and warg, one family per row; idle, windup, attack contact, hurt. Recognisable silhouettes, weathered natural materials, transparent background, no borrowed game models or film designs.
assets.preparation: Manually bounded rows; transparent cells; family-specific frame selection.

assets.brief: Original Uruk warrior, barrow-wight, faceless dark rider and giant spider. Four distinct poses per family: idle, anticipation, attack, hurt. Isometric painterly realistic style consistent with the traveller. No film costumes or actor likenesses.
assets.preparation: Transparent 4×4 atlas; runtime transforms provide additional movement/death feedback.

assets.brief: Original mossy oak, birch, fir, deadwood, boulders, stones, outcrop, fallen log, fern, flowers, reeds, grass, runestone, low wall, wooden bridge and stump. Isometric detailed woodland material studies with strong readable silhouettes, transparent background, restrained forest palette.
assets.preparation: Manually bounded components, trimmed transparent borders, resized and packed; matching nature-atlas.json.

assets.brief: Original solitary green-cloaked traveller at a ruined stone bridge, a winding northern river, forested valley and distant abandoned beacon towers. A tiny warm lantern promises shelter. Wide cinematic illustration, atmospheric depth, left side suitable for readable story text, no text in artwork.
assets.preparation: Inspected, resized to 1680 px width, WebP quality 86.
